text:
noah_pm: Quick ping AltChip ready for a compact joint bench next week. We need to confirm workload names, metric tags, and signing for the marketplace image. 10-15 minute dry-run preferred.

lee_altchip: Works for us. We'll bring a focused kernel bundle (altchip-mini-v1) and the thermal profile. Need the exact tag set you want in CSV.

sam_eng: Minimal workload list: gen_long (llama-70b, seq=2048, batch=1, 10m), chat_steady (llama-70b, seq=512, batch=8, 10m), embed_surge (opt-13b, batch=64, 5m). Tags: run_id, model, seq, batch, kernel_sha, fw_rev, rack.

bench-bot: reproducible CLI:
```
benchctl run --partner altchip --workload gen_long --model redwood/llama-70b \
  --seq 2048 --batch 1 --duration 600 --sensors ipmi,pmbus --tags run_id,model,kernel_sha
```
CSV columns: timestamp, tokens_sec, p50_ms, p95_ms, watts, gpu_temp, tag_run_id

ryan_sre: Telemetry/security notes: allowlist partner IPs for pull, include IPMI/PMBus metrics, and create an audit record before any external sharing. Marketplace image must be signed by both parties.

noah_pm: Owners set: Sam (workloads & S3 artifacts), Lee (kernel bundle), Ryan (telemetry & signing). I'll coordinate marketing assets after dry-run. Meeting invite incoming. :white_check_mark:
